name: waypoint-system
author: BlaXun
description: Travel you earn instead of a free warper. Waypoint boards stand on 41 fields and dungeon floors, low to high level. Bring a board the items its monsters drop and it attunes to you; from then on a Waypoint Keeper in any town sends you there for a fee, and the board sends you back. Both eras. Every waypoint, with its board position, the items it asks for and its travel fee per era, is one row of registry/tools/waypoint-system/waypoints.csv in the app repository, built into this mod's scripts; the README says how to add one.

settings.label: Waypoints are shared by the whole account
settings.description: Off: each character attunes to waypoints on its own. On: a waypoint any of your characters attuned to works for all of them. Both are always saved, so switching back and forth loses nothing.

settings.label: Travel fee (%)
settings.description: Every Waypoint Keeper fee, as a percentage of the waypoint's own fee: 100 as listed, 50 half, 0 free once attuned. The fees themselves are set per waypoint in the mod's source (registry/tools/waypoint-system/waypoints.csv).

settings.label: Items to attune (%)
settings.description: How many items each board asks for, as a percentage: 100 as listed, 50 half, 200 twice as many. Never less than one of each. The items themselves are set per waypoint in the mod's source (registry/tools/waypoint-system/waypoints.csv).

settings.label: Keepers list boards you have found
settings.description: On: a Waypoint Keeper also lists boards you have visited but not attuned to yet, marked (not attuned), as a reminder. Off: only attuned waypoints are listed.
